title: THE tSZ OBSERVING PROPOSAL: G113's zero-parameter y-profile as a real pre-registered measurement on the 12 X-COP clusters
recipe: per cluster: y(theta) from G113's recipe re-implemented (committed X-COP gas x the G095 closed form T_vir(r) = mu m_p G M_HSE(<r)/(2 k_B r), Abel projection, gas envelope r^-q + phantom A/r^2 continuation, gated digit-for-digit vs G113_results.json); y -> dT_CMB = T_CMB y g(x), g(x) = x coth(x/2) - 4; survey noise per beam = sigma_arcmin/sqrt(beam area); bin noise = sigma_beam/sqrt(N_beams in annulus); chi2 separation at the forecast noise with common-y0 normalization

ACT_DR6_f090.src: ACT DR6 maps; median combined depth ~10 uK-arcmin (19,000 deg2); 98 GHz beam 2.2'

SO_LAT_93.src: SO Science-Goals baseline: ~6 uK-arcmin white noise (combined 93+145 GHz), 40% sky

SO_deep_93.src: the task's given deep class ~1.6 uK-arcmin (deep SAT fields)

Planck_217.src: Planck 2018 I Table 4: 0.78 uK-deg = 46.8 uK-arcmin; the tSZ-null control

falsifiers.F1_G095_extension_kill: measured log-slope at theta in [theta_500, 2 theta_500] steeper than -2.0 at >= 3 sigma -> the extension of the G095 identification (T = virial temperature of the total mass) outside R500 is killed (G113 V3's decision line)
falsifiers.F2_phantom_zone_kill: measured slope flatter than the registered per-cluster band [-(q-1)-0.4, -(q-1)+0.4] at >= 3 sigma (slope > -(q-1)+0.4) -> the phantom-zone pressure profile as registered (T_vir -> T_inf = 2 T_floor isotherm x the gas envelope r^-q) is killed
falsifiers.pass_window: median slope in (-1.7, -0.9) and per-cluster within the band at <= 2 sigma; window-average y/y(2/3) consistent with the predicted 40-105x (common y0 convention)
falsifiers.amplitude_consistency: y0 within the ~0.05-dex HSE budget: a violation indicts the X-COP calibration, not the framework (non-decisive by construction, G113 V3 (1))

controls: beta-model fit comparison over b in (0.05, 0.8) R500 with the free family (y0b, r_c, beta): framework predicts beta_eff median 0.42 (10/12 well-constrained; classic band 0.5-0.8); the inner fit's extrapolation to 2 R500 vs the measured outer bins is the model-independent closure

cluster subtraction for the Planck beams: PSZ2/ACT neighbour catalogues, iterated subtraction of neighbouring clusters and LSS filament signal, point-source masks, local background annuli at 2.5-3.5 theta_500 (zero-level removal)
the 217 GHz channel as the tSZ-null control (g(217) ~ 0.01): the null map monitors CIB+dust leakage into the y estimate
353 GHz dust templates and CO masks (100/217 GHz) in the ILC

jackknife suite: Planck half-mission maps, ACT day/night and array splits, pipeline cross-checks MILCA vs NILC vs matched filter (NEMO-class); bootstrapped noise realizations for the bin covariance and the chi2
resolution overlap: ACT/SO inner bins and Planck outer bins overlap in 3-8 arcmin; the joint fit enforces consistency and bounds the beam-transfer systematic
pipeline: 1. DATA PRODUCTS: Planck HFI 100/143/217/353 GHz maps + masks; ACT DR5/DR6 f090/f150/f220 maps + inverse variance (LAMBDA); the Coulton+24 arcminute y-map over ~13,000 deg2; SO survey maps (when public); PSZ2; the X-COP profiles (committed)

2. y-MAP EXTRACTION per survey: ILC/NILC component separation over the survey's frequency set (CMB, dust, synchrotron, CO; the 217 GHz null as the CIB monitor; 353 GHz dust templates), producing y maps + per-pixel noise maps and masks; cross-check with map-space matched filtering (Melin-class NEMO)

3. RADIAL PROFILE: inverse-noise-weighted annular means on the y maps at the cluster position (bins per survey as listed), model profiles convolved by the survey beam; bin covariance from the noise maps; 100 noise realizations for the covariance

4. MODEL COMPARISON (chi2 per prediction): per cluster, per bin set: M1 = the G113 zero-parameter profile (no fitted parameters); M2 = classic beta = 2/3, r_c = 0.15 R500 (common y0); M3 = the free beta-family self-fit over (0.05, 0.8) R500 extrapolated; report chi2, Delta chi2, BIC per cluster and pooled; the F1/F2 decision lines and the pass window are applied to the M1 residuals

verdicts.V1_proposal_complete: TARGETS (12/12 with sky positions from the committed FITS headers, z from Ettori+19), PREDICTION (y0 median 7.77e-5, slope -1.44 at 2R500, 40x/105x at R500/2R500 vs the classic beta=2/3, the G095 T-extension), INSTRUMENT (ACT/SO ~1.4' inside theta_M 4.7'; Planck 5-10' on the phantom zone; per-cluster footprint check), EXPOSURE/SNR (per cluster central SNR 25-64 Planck 143 / 20-51 ACT f150; per-bin table; slope error 0.32), FALSIFIERS (F1 steeper than -2 at theta_500 kills the G095 extension; F2 flatter than [-(q-1)-0.4, -(q-1)+0.4] kills the phantom-zone pressure reading as registered), CONTROLS (beta-model fit comparison over (0.05, 0.8) R500 with beta_eff 0.42 vs the classic 0.5-0.8 band; neighbour-cluster subtraction for the Planck beams, 217 GHz null, 353 GHz dust, half-mission and pipeline jackknives) -- the proposal is complete and executable as written
verdicts.V2_snr_forecast: per cluster central beam-averaged SNR (per-channel, no ILC penalty): ACT f150 median 20 (range 5-51) over the 7 in-band clusters; Planck 143 median 25 (range 9-64); SO deep 1.6 uK-arcmin median 206 (LAT 6 uK-arcmin: 55).  The DECISION bins (phantom zone): Planck 143 median bin SNR 10.2 (8-12'), 9.3 (12-17'), 7.8 (17-23'), 6.6 (23-31', ~2 theta_500); the strongest outer bins on the bright clusters (A2029, A2142, A2319) reach SNR 15-60.  Slope decision: the conservative 2-bin slope error over [theta_500, 2 theta_500] is median 0.32 per cluster -> pooled 0.09 over the sample: F1 (-2 vs -1.44) at ~6 sigma, F2 (the flat band edge) at ~5 sigma pooled (multi-bin fits improve per-cluster to ~0.15).  Model separation at forecast noise: median chi2 vs beta=2/3 3087, vs beta=0.7 3197.  Scale: all SNRs scale linearly with the 1.4x ILC penalty applied for component separation (stated assumption); exposure is END-OF-SURVEY depth for ACT/Planck (already archived), SO as published
verdicts.V3_statement: DOES THIS PROPOSAL DECIDE THE PHANTOM-ZONE PRESSURE SIGNATURE?  DECIDES, WITH QUALIFICATION.  (1) WHAT IT DECIDES CLEANLY: the per-cluster outer Compton shape at theta in [theta_500, 2 theta_500] (median 15.5' to 31') at Planck 143 GHz bin SNR 10.2 (8-12'), 9.3 (12-17'), 7.8 (17-23'), 6.6 (23-31'), with a conservative 2-bin slope error of 0.32 per cluster (a multi-bin fit over the four outer bins reaches ~0.15), i.e. 0.09 pooled over the 12 -> the F1 decision line (steeper than -2 at theta_500, killing the G095 extension) separates at ~2 sigma per cluster and ~6 sigma pooled; the F2 line (flatter than the registered [-(q-1)-0.4, -(q-1)+0.4] band, killing the T_inf-isotherm x gas-envelope reading) at ~1.5 sigma per cluster, ~5 sigma pooled.  The model separation vs the classic beta = 2/3 profile is chi2 ~ 3087 (median combined, common-y0 shape comparison; 12/12 clusters > 25).  The inner profile (theta < theta_M, the r_M crossing at 4.7') is ACT/SO-resolved at central SNR 20 for the 7/12 clusters inside the public ACT band (A1795, A2142, A2255, A2319, RXC1825 are outside it and get Planck-alone inner coverage).  (2) WHAT IT DECIDES ONLY PARTIALLY: (i) the 40x/105x phantom-zone multiples are ratios vs the CLASSIC beta = 2/3, r_c = 0.15 R500 convention -- the physically scored quantities are the absolute convolved per-cluster curves and the slope; (ii) A644 (q = 3.8, the steepest gas envelope) carries only ~2.6x hold-up -- for it the signature is a factor, not two decades; (iii) a profile in the framework band confirms the outer pressure hold-up but the mechanism attribution (phantom vs dust envelope vs active EFE cap) is NOT one measurement: the capped reading would steepen the profile back toward the beta family, so the measurement DISCRIMINATES capped vs uncapped (G108's window) but does not by itself prove the phantom density profile rho = A/r^2; (iv) the amplitude y0 is a consistency test (the ~0.05-dex HSE budget), not a free prediction.  (3) WHO CAN RUN IT: any SZ analyst.  All inputs are public today: Planck HFI 100/143/217/353 GHz 2018 maps and the MILCA/NILC y-maps; ACT DR5/DR6 maps (LAMBDA) and the Coulton et al. 2024 arcminute y-map over ~13,000 deg2; the Planck PSZ2 catalog for neighbour subtraction; X-COP profiles (committed in this repo and public); public tools healpy/NILC/fgbuster and matched-filter codes.  No observing time is requested -- this is a pre-registered analysis proposal whose decision rules (F1/F2, the band windows, the chi2 convention, the common-y0 normalization) are fixed in deepseek_push/TSZ_PROPOSAL.md BEFORE the maps are read.  Runtime: ~2-4 weeks of postdoc-level analysis per survey; the SO numbers scale the same thresholds in uK-arcmin when SO maps become public.
